statements.impact_statement: REEVALUATE (touched): merged PR #44 edited element-view.tsx, so the finding resurfaced. Re-verified against current code: the dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink at element-view.tsx:312 still reads `element.textContent`, and the openLinksInNewTab click handler added in this file only calls `window.open(link.href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')` on anchor clicks — it does not construct HTML or widen attacker reach. The inline mitigation that justified the prior disposition is still in place: lesson text passes through `sanitizeRichText` (backend/src/config/rich-text.ts:53, backed by `sanitize-html`) on write — called from curriculum-service.ts:1267 and :1356 before storage. Re-confirmed not_affected with a fresh 90-day window.

REEVALUATE (touched): merged PR #44 edited curriculum-controller.ts, so the finding resurfaced. Re-verified against current code at line 533: `res.send(result)` where `result` is the return value of EditLeaseService.release or EditLeaseService.releaseAll (edit-lease-service.ts:82-91). release returns `{released: boolean}` (`count > 0`), releaseAll returns `{released: number}` (Prisma updateMany count). Neither payload contains any user-supplied string — the two literal keys and primitive values are entirely server-constructed. `res.send` on an object auto-serialises to JSON with Content-Type application/json, which a browser cannot render as HTML. Original disposition re-confirmed with a fresh 90-day window.
